faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel suitable for Oval slit-valve sealing bezel for wafer transfer?
faq.a: Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chamber hardware components receive Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.
